Wahapedia datasheet 000001031 (Magnus the Red), Daemon Primarch: "If your army is Battle-forged, this model must be your army's WARLORD." (also research library 03_Codexes/Chaos/Thousand_Sons.md §6: must be Warlord). BSData v9.8.0 leaves Magnus's Warlord link (d5e1-3d49-96dc-7667) optional, unlike Mortarion's and Abaddon's, so another Warlord beside Magnus went unreported. A min of 1 on that link makes him the Warlord, like Abaddon's own link.
